description: The corrected pairing propagation law, the u=0 re-attribution of GGM (92)/(93), and the residue that survives every index variant — recorded as a characterised blocker.
verdict: BLOCKER, characterised. Part 3 retracted the invariance premise; the correct law is G_{M+1} = A_M G_M (Abar^T)^{-1}, inverted because GGM (92) moves its two indices in OPPOSITE directions. It still does not close: entries (1,0) and (2,0) survive every index variant tried. Three causes remain unseparated and are named rather than guessed between. The next honest step is to read the u=0 section's own operator and J from the source instead of importing (254) and an OCR'd J across sections.
